title: Caravanserais of the Silk Roads: a day's march apart?
excerpt: 960 caravanserais, khans and ribats from Wikidata and OpenStreetMap on a hand-inked map. All together they crowd closer than a day's march; one dynasty at a time, the Safavid caravanserais of Iran stand a median 34 km apart.
seo_description: A hand-inked map of the caravanserais of the Silk Roads from open data: where they are, how far apart they stand and who built them.
header_alt: Title card reading 'Caravanserais of the Silk Roads' in black and red on parchment, beside a hand-inked map of Anatolia and Iran dotted with tiny drawings of caravanserais. Text: 960 caravanserais; Safavid ones stand 34 km apart, a day's march.
